description: Portable vLLM inference observability, GPU telemetry, traffic distribution, capacity, and unit economics dashboard.

options.content:
- Reference workload: four TP1 vLLM replicas with one GPU per pod.
- Application metrics come from each vLLM /metrics endpoint; DCGM provides per-GPU utilization, memory, power, and temperature.
- Instance hourly USD is the price per GPU node. Billed instances is the number of nodes allocated to the selected workload.
- Cost panels allocate the full selected cluster cost to this workload and return no data when request or token rate is zero.
- Local port forwarding can pin traffic to one backend; use the in-cluster AIPerf runner to prove Service distribution.
- Executive and Unit Economics panels show the current five-minute state. Historical panels use the selected Grafana range.
